Ihold leaves a 0.6A margin above the +5V/0.5A rail current budget and Vmax leaves a 28V margin above the +5V nominal rail voltage; both margins are large and healthy, so PTC2 passes its rail-application check without qualification.

The single-page Techfuse specification sheet does not tabulate ambient-temperature-derated hold current or environmental/aging test data (unlike the RUILON and BHFUSE datasheets for PTC1/PTC3), and no board-b generator spec exists yet to bound upstream fault current/energy, in-enclosure ambient, or trip-cycling history at PTC2.
